title: 有限度数网络零模型的采样误差预算
hypothesis: For an actual unrestricted undirected degree-vector workload using exactly the source kernel, a dimension-only TV stopping certificate can be compiled without proving P-stability. Any practical improvement over audited older bounds must be measured separately and may be zero.
mapping: Vertices are labelled entities; observed degree vector defines all simple undirected realizations. Compile T=ceil(gamma0^-1 max(0,(B/2)log2-log(2 epsilon))) for0<epsilon<1, gamma0^-1=24 n^2 C(n,4),B=C(n,2), using the source TV bound and M<=2^B. Singleton can use time0 if actually certified. General T is a derived conservative budget, not an exact sampler.
judge: First freeze a genuine public undirected workload, exact proposal code, epsilon and resource budget. Independent source/kernel review and bounded exact full-law fixtures assess compilation; actual workload feasibility and comparison with older applicable bounds assess application benefit. Perturbation-score stabilization alone cannot judge TV.
baseline: P-stable or degree-conditioned old bounds after exact kernel normalization; valid existing undirected Curveball implementations as separate practical alternatives. CBS18 modified experimental proposals cannot inherit this bound by name alone.
limits: No workload, finite implementation, practical runtime allocation or external check yet. n^8 and epsilon budgets may be prohibitive. Extra connectedness, forbidden edges, weights, direction or geometry invalidate direct transfer. Certified burn-in is not an exact finite output law.
prediction_kind: Availability of a conservative all-degree certificate; no speedup claimed
resource_envelope: No numerical allocation. Do not execute exponential graph enumeration or long chains before workload and bounded protocol are fixed. Future numerical raw,summary,source payloads gzip and decompressed hashes verified before removing plaintext.
